title: EIP-8094: eth/vhash - Blob-Aware Mempool
author: Csaba Kiraly (@cskiraly)
laymanDescription: Raising the fee on a pending blob transaction currently means resending its entire data payload across the network, even though that data has not changed. This proposal separates the two: blob transactions travel without their data, and a node fetches the data by content only when it does not already have it.
benefits: A fee bump no longer resends blob data that peers already hold
Saves bandwidth exactly during fee volatility, when the network is already congested
Blob transactions can be broadcast directly again, since they no longer carry the payload
tradeoffs: Fetching data separately adds a round trip per hop to blob propagation
Peers may return only some requested blobs, so a fetch can come back incomplete
How this combines with the sparse blobpool proposal is left unresolved
